snippets.MAZEGAME_POPUP_LOST_BOMB: The bomb rolled through the gate and exploded inside the machine.
snippets.MAZEGAME_POPUP_LOST_FIELDS: Unfortunately, all the tiles are blocked. Please try again.
snippets.MAZEGAME_POPUP_LOST_GATES: Unfortunately, all the exits are blocked. The best thing to do, is to try again!
snippets.MAZEGAME_POPUP_LOST_TURN: You don't have any tiles left. Why not try again.
snippets.MAZEGAME_POPUP_WON_CATEGORY_COINS: You have reached the goal $$gatename$$. You will now get an item and $$amountcoins$$ coins.
snippets.MAZEGAME_TUTORIAL_TEXT_1_1: Create a path from the start of the maze to one of the exits.
snippets.MAZEGAME_TUTORIAL_TEXT_1_2: Drag one of the three path-tiles from the right side of the screen on the game-field. Three new tiles spawn then.
snippets.MAZEGAME_TUTORIAL_TEXT_2_1: Blocker-Tiles spawn randomly on the gamefield.
snippets.MAZEGAME_TUTORIAL_TEXT_2_2: Hammers can destroy tiles. Drag the hammers on a path or a blocker to destroy it.
snippets.MAZEGAME_TUTORIAL_TEXT_2_3: "Empty" tiles spawn randomly and blockade a free tile-slot.
snippets.MAZEGAME_TUTORIAL_TEXT_3_1: Pickup goldcoins to get a money bonus! Build a path to the exit through their square to collect them.
snippets.MAZEGAME_TUTORIAL_TEXT_3_2: Attention, some mazes have turn limit, time limits, or the exits disappear! Always keep an eye on the counters!
snippets.MAZEGAME_TUTORIAL_TEXT_3_3: There are more special rules that will hinder your path to the exit! Keep your eyes open and be ready for strange things happening in the maze.
snippets.MAZEGAME_TUTORIAL_TEXT_4_1: After completing the maze, you can spin the Wheel of Luck to get a reward. Push the red button to start the wheel.
snippets.MAZEGAME_WHEEL_POPUP_TEXT: Congratulations! You have won the $$itemname$$ and you have also received the Magic Staff!
